meta.name: smart-explore
meta.description: Token-optimized structural code search using tree-sitter AST parsing. Use instead of reading full files when you need to understand code structure, find functions, or explore a codebase efficiently.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用AST解析快速搜索代码结构，替代逐文件阅读
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要在不熟悉的代码库中快速找到函数或结构
copy.tagline_en: Search code structure quickly with AST parsing, replacing full file reads
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to quickly find functions or structures in unfamiliar codebases

howto.what: 探索代码时,它改用三个结构化工具:smart_search 查找文件与符号、smart_outline 给出文件骨架、smart_unfold 只展开指定函数,并按需返回源码。
howto.when: 当你需要理解代码结构、查找函数或探索代码库时触发;技能激活期间接管默认探索行为,用 smart_* 工具替代 Read、Grep、Glob。

howto.what_en: It replaces default code exploration with three structural tools: smart_search finds files and symbols, smart_outline shows a file skeleton, and smart_unfold expands only the needed functions, returning names and line numbers.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need to understand code structure, find functions or explore a codebase; while active it takes over default exploration, using smart_* tools instead of Read, Grep and Glob.
